limits: Controlled loopback fault recovery is not a measurement of natural YouTube availability.
Fresh external sample size is one short recording; historical 0.5.1 multi-hour corpus evidence is separate.
Active attempt durations are excluded; this is not an overall wall-clock deadline.
The caller must relaunch resume after process death; no detached scheduler is added.
YouTube can remove content or deny every available client; no unconditional access guarantee.
ASR accuracy and completeness of recognized speech remain unverified.
